extra.summary: No annual fee for life. Advertises one of the highest cash back at 10%, but only for selected categories and limited by cashback cap.

our_takes.our-take: The CIMB Visa Signature targets online shoppers and those frequenting beauty, wellness, and pet-related establishments. To unlock the 10% cashback, you'll need to hit a monthly spend of $800, with cashback capped at $20 per category and $100 overall. It makes sense if your spending aligns with the bonus categories. Otherwise, a general cashback card might be a better fit given the high minimum spend.
our_takes.good-for:
Ideal for young professionals seeking cashback on online shopping, groceries, and beauty/wellness purchases.
Great for pet owners who frequently spend on pet shop items and veterinary services.
Suited for individuals who can meet the minimum S$800 monthly spend to maximize cashback.
our_takes.things-to-note:
A minimum spend of $800 is needed each month; otherwise, you won't receive cashback rewards.
Cashback is capped at $20 per category, limiting your total potential earnings each statement month.
A high 27.80% annual interest rate applies if you don't pay your balance in full monthly.
